comment: EU labelled fill is 1.5 ML versus 1.56 ML in RxNorm. Both pens deliver 30 doses of 80 micrograms in 0.04 ML at 2 MG/ML. EMA documents 0.3 ML overfill for priming. Treated as clinically equivalent multidose pens based on identical delivered dose and dose count, rather than literal fill-volume equality.
